issues.where: crops U and V, lower left and lower right ring arcs
issues.what: Multiple ring strands lose contrast over the same short span, so the bright outer arc reads like a cut-off stroke on both sides instead of a continuous ring in shadow.
issues.fix: Keep the strands continuous through the shadow and vary their opacity and falloff so they do not terminate together.

issues.where: crops P and Q, left-side polar region and center of the shadowed globe
issues.what: The left side resolves into a broad, soft oval swirl, while the adjacent surface turns into long, parallel, smeared bands with little fine structure. The distortion is visible in the full frame.
issues.fix: Reduce the apparent polar stretching and add irregular, resolved cloud structure across the darker bands.

issues.where: across the upper third of the globe, at the terminator
issues.what: The shadow falls in a broad, uniformly soft strip that suppresses cloud texture and gives the transition an airbrushed look.
issues.fix: Preserve low-contrast cloud detail through the transition and vary the penumbra with the cloud structure.

issues.where: crops C and G, sunlit limb
issues.what: A near-white rim sits under a broad cyan glow, making the edge look outlined against the rings and star field.
issues.fix: Lower the peak rim intensity and let the atmospheric glow taper continuously into the surrounding sky.
